def match_parens(lst):

    Return 'Yes' if there's a way to make a good string, and return 'No' otherwise.

    Examples:

    '''

user_prompt:
method match_parens(lst: array<string>) returns (result: string)
    requires |lst| == 2
    requires forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |lst| ==> (lst[i] == "(" || lst[i] == ")")
    ensures result == "Yes" || result == "No"
    ensures result == "Yes" <==> (IsGood(lst[0] + lst[1]) || IsGood(lst[1] + lst[0]))
    
method IsGood(s: string) returns (isBalanced: bool)
    ensures isBalanced <==> (CountOpen(s) == CountClose(s) && ValidParentheses(s))
    
method CountOpen(s: string) returns (count: int)
    ensures count >= 0
    
method CountClose(s: string) returns (count: int)
    ensures count >= 0
    
method ValidParentheses(s: string) returns (valid: bool)
    ensures valid <==> (forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |s| ==> (Balance(s, i) >= 0))
    
method Balance(s: string, index: int) returns (balance: int)
    requires 0 <= index < |s|
    ensures balance == CountOpen(s[0..index]) - CountClose(s[0..index])
